name: dialog
title: Dialog 对话框
description: 覆盖在页面上的窗口，用于需要专注完成的内容或表单，背后内容不可操作。

whenToUse: 需要用户专注完成的短流程或表单

whenNotToUse.case: 从边缘滑出的辅助面板

files.content:
# Dialog 设计规范

- 每个 `Dialog.Content` 都要有 `Dialog.Title`；界面上不想显示标题时给它加 `class="sr-only"`，不要删掉（检查规则 `valar/overlay-title`）。需要补充说明时加 `Dialog.Description`。
- 打开对话框的按钮通过 `Dialog.Trigger` 的 `{#snippet child({ props })}` 把 `props` 传给 `Button`；不要在 Trigger 里再放一个 Button（检查规则 `valar/trigger-child-snippet`）。
- 工作区紧凑编辑器可用 `Dialog.Content appearance="editor"`。标题与正文仍使用各自的组件，正文可能过长时保留弹窗的内部滚动。
- 普通弹窗居中，宽度上限 480 px，12 px 圆角，标题与表单共用浅深主题表面。操作栏按原有顺序换行，主次操作用同尺寸的胶囊按钮。
- 内边距、内容间距、圆角档位、遮罩不透明度、动效档位和出现时缩放都是组件参数，在 Dialog 文档页的编辑器中调整并写回组件库；不要在 `Dialog.Content` 上用 `class` 改 `p-*`、`gap-*`、`rounded-*`、`duration-*`、`zoom-*`。
- 宽度默认取组件参数的宽度档；个别对话框确需更宽时只加 `sm:max-w-*` 档位类，不写像素任意值。
- 操作按钮放在 `Dialog.Footer`，最多一个主按钮（见 Button 规范）。取消按钮用 `Dialog.Close` 的 `child` snippet 包一个 `variant="outline"` 的 Button。
- 右上角关闭按钮（`showCloseButton`，默认开启）和 `Dialog.Footer` 的 `showCloseButton` 自带的文字默认是“关闭”，其他语言用各自的 `closeLabel` 改。
- 弹窗默认在视口内滚动。需保持页首或操作栏可见时，给正文单独设置滚动，并用 `minmax(0, 1fr)` 限制正文所在网格行。
- 异步提交时通过按钮的 `loading` 保留焦点并阻止重复提交。失败后保留已输入的值，显示错误和重试。业务需要时，可在 `onEscapeKeydown` 和 `onInteractOutside` 内阻止等待中的关闭。
- 需要在代码中开关时用 `bind:open`；关闭后焦点会自动回到触发按钮，不要手动把焦点移到别处。
- 确认危险操作改用 Alert Dialog；从屏幕边缘滑出的辅助面板用 Sheet；移动端底部面板用 Drawer。

<script lang="ts">
	import { DialogClose as SdkClose } from "@ui-sdk/svelte/dialog";
	import type { ActionDetails } from "@ui-sdk/core";
	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
	import type { HTMLButtonAttributes } from "svelte/elements";
	import { bindElementRef } from "./context.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		type = "button",
		value,
		action,
		children,
		child,
		...restProps
	}: Omit<HTMLButtonAttributes, "children" | "value"> & {
		ref?: HTMLButtonElement | HTMLElement | null;
		value?: string;
		action?: (event: Event | undefined, details: ActionDetails) => unknown;
		child?: Snippet<[{ props: Record<string, unknown> }]>;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	const refAttachment = bindElementRef<HTMLElement>((el) => {
		ref = el;
	});
</script>

<SdkClose {type} {value} {action} data-slot="dialog-close" {...restProps}>

			{@render child({ props: attributes })}
		{:else}
			<button {...attributes}>{@render children?.()}</button>
		{/if}

</SdkClose>

<script lang="ts">
	import {
		DialogTrigger as SdkTrigger,
		type DialogController,
	} from "@ui-sdk/svelte/dialog";
	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
	import type { HTMLButtonAttributes } from "svelte/elements";
	import { bindElementRef } from "./context.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		type = "button",
		disabled,
		focusableWhenDisabled,
		payload,
		shortcut,
		controller,
		children,
		child,
		...restProps
	}: Omit<HTMLButtonAttributes, "children"> & {
		ref?: HTMLButtonElement | HTMLElement | null;
		focusableWhenDisabled?: boolean;
		payload?: unknown;
		shortcut?: string;
		controller?: DialogController<unknown, unknown>;
		child?: Snippet<[{ props: Record<string, unknown> }]>;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	const refAttachment = bindElementRef<HTMLElement>((el) => {
		ref = el;
	});
</script>

<SdkTrigger
	{type}
	disabled={disabled ?? undefined}
	{focusableWhenDisabled}
	{payload}
	{shortcut}
	{controller}
	data-slot="dialog-trigger"
	{...restProps}
>
	{#snippet render({ props, state })}
		{@const attributes = {
			...props,
			"data-state": state.open ? "open" : "closed",
			...refAttachment,
		}}
		{#if child}
			{@render child({ props: attributes })}
		{:else}
			<button {...attributes}>{@render children?.()}</button>
		{/if}
	{/snippet}
</SdkTrigger>

<script lang="ts">
	import {
		Dialog as SdkDialog,
		type DialogController,
		type DialogDismissAttemptDetails,
		type DialogOpenChangeDetails,
		type DialogPayloadChangeReason,
	} from "@ui-sdk/svelte/dialog";
	import type { ChangeDetails } from "@ui-sdk/core";
	import { getContext, setContext, type Snippet } from "svelte";
	import { DIALOG_POLICY_KEY, type DialogDismissPolicy } from "./context.js";

	const PARENT_ESCAPE_KEY = Symbol.for("valar-dialog-parent-escape");

	let {
		open = $bindable(false),
		defaultOpen,
		modal: modalProp,
		closeOnOutsidePress,
		presentation = "dialog",
		controller,
		dismissible,
		persistentElements,
		pendingAnnouncement,
		container,
		onOpenChange,
		onOpenChangeComplete,
		onPayloadChange,
		onDismissAttempt,
		children,
	}: {
		open?: boolean;
		defaultOpen?: boolean;
		modal?: boolean | "trap-focus";
		closeOnOutsidePress?: boolean;
		presentation?: "auto" | "dialog" | "sheet";
		controller?: DialogController<unknown, unknown>;
		dismissible?: boolean;
		persistentElements?: (Element | string)[] | (() => Element[]);
		pendingAnnouncement?: string;
		container?: Element | DocumentFragment | null;
		onOpenChange?: (open: boolean, details?: DialogOpenChangeDetails) => void;
		onOpenChangeComplete?: (open: boolean) => void;
		onPayloadChange?: (
			payload: unknown,
			details: ChangeDetails<DialogPayloadChangeReason>
		) => void;
		onDismissAttempt?: (details: DialogDismissAttemptDetails) => void;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	let policy = $state<DialogDismissPolicy>({});
	const effectiveModal = $derived(
		modalProp !== undefined ? modalProp : policy.trapFocus === false ? false : true
	);
	const parentEscape = getContext<(() => void) | undefined>(PARENT_ESCAPE_KEY);

	setContext(PARENT_ESCAPE_KEY, () => {
		if (
			policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "ignore" ||
			policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore"
		) {
			parentEscape?.();
			return;
		}
		open = false;
		onOpenChange?.(false);
	});

	setContext(DIALOG_POLICY_KEY, {
		set(next: DialogDismissPolicy) {
			policy = next;
		},
		isOpen: () => Boolean(open),
		isModal: () => effectiveModal !== false,
		requestEscapeClose(event: KeyboardEvent) {
			if (!open || effectiveModal === false) return;
			if (
				policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "ignore" ||
				policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore"
			) {
				if (policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore") {
					parentEscape?.();
				}
				return;
			}
			if (policy.onEscapeKeydown) {
				const synthetic = new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape", cancelable: true });
				policy.onEscapeKeydown(synthetic);
				if (synthetic.defaultPrevented) return;
			}
			event.preventDefault();
			event.stopPropagation();
			open = false;
			onOpenChange?.(false);
		},
	});

	function handleOpenChange(next: boolean, details: DialogOpenChangeDetails) {
		if (!next) {
			if (
				details.reason === "outside-press" &&
				(policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "ignore" ||
					policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore")
			) {
				details.cancel();
				return;
			}
			if (
				details.reason === "escape-key" &&
				(policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "ignore" ||
					policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore")
			) {
				details.cancel();
				if (policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore") {
					parentEscape?.();
				}
				return;
			}
			if (details.reason === "outside-press" && policy.onInteractOutside) {
				const event = new CustomEvent("interactOutside", {
					cancelable: true,
					detail: { originalEvent: details.event },
				});
				policy.onInteractOutside(event);
				if (event.defaultPrevented) {
					details.cancel();
					return;
				}
			}
			if (details.reason === "escape-key" && policy.onEscapeKeydown) {
				const event = new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape", cancelable: true });
				policy.onEscapeKeydown(event);
				if (event.defaultPrevented) {
					details.cancel();
					return;
				}
			}
		}
		onOpenChange?.(next, details);
		if (!next && !details.canceled && details.reason === "escape-key") {
			details.event?.stopPropagation();
		}
	}
</script>

<SdkDialog
	bind:open
	{defaultOpen}
	modal={effectiveModal}
	{closeOnOutsidePress}
	{presentation}
	{controller}
	{dismissible}
	{persistentElements}
	{pendingAnnouncement}
	{container}
	onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}
	{onOpenChangeComplete}
	{onPayloadChange}
	{onDismissAttempt}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</SdkDialog>
